lesson_intent.one_sentence_goal: Practice narrating a completed everyday event with preteritum and clear time markers.
lesson_intent.real_life_context: Explaining what happened yesterday during errands or transport.
lesson_intent.communicative_function: Telling a short past event in a practical way.

dialogue_task.scenario: Anna and Erik talk about a small problem that happened yesterday while doing errands.

main_focus.name: preteritum for completed past events
main_focus.description: Use preteritum with clear past-time markers such as i går and i morse for events that are finished.
main_focus.desired_presence: Use preteritum naturally 5-6 times in the dialogue.

avoid_grammar: detailed perfect tense contrast as the main focus

vocabulary_target.desired_presence: Use everyday verbs in preteritum, especially for errands and transport.

dialogue_shape.opening: One person asks why the other was delayed or busy yesterday.
dialogue_shape.middle: A short sequence of two or three completed events is explained with one practical problem.
dialogue_shape.ending: They mention whether the problem was solved or what still needs to happen.

target_complexity.repetition: repeat common preteritum forms in a natural recap

focus: what happened during the past errand
what problem occurred in the sequence

sentence_focus: one sentence starting with i går plus preteritum
one sentence with i morse plus preteritum
one sentence using först or sedan
one sentence about forgetting or missing something
one sentence saying the problem was solved
